# hallpass_api_credential (Resource)

The credential HallPass adds to an API access profile's requests. The secret is encrypted in HallPass, never returned and never shown to agents; Terraform keeps it in state (sensitive), so protect the state. Changing it applies to the next proxied request. Destroying it removes the credential: the profile's requests fail until a new one is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_api_credential" "github_read" {
  role_id = hallpass_api_access_profile.read.id
  type    = "bearer"
  secret  = var.github_read_token # a fine-grained token with read-only permissions
}

resource "hallpass_api_credential" "gcp" {
  role_id = hallpass_api_access_profile.gcp_read.id
  type    = "google_service_account"
  secret  = file("gcp-viewer-key.json")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) API access profile ID (`rol_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The token, password or service account key.
- `type` (String) `bearer` (`Authorization: Bearer <secret>`), `header` (`<header>: <secret>`), `basic` (HTTP Basic with `username`) or `google_service_account` (a service account key in JSON; HallPass sends short-lived access tokens).

### Optional

- `header` (String) Header name for type `header`, e.g. `X-Api-Key`.
- `scopes` (List of String) OAuth scopes for type `google_service_account` (default `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform`).
- `username` (String) Username for type `basic`.

### Read-Only

- `hint` (String) The secret's last four characters, or the service account's email.
- `id` (String) The access profile ID (the credential has no ID of its own).
- `version` (Number) Increases with every change.
